# Network Flow Monitor v0.1.0

[中文说明](#-中文说明) | [English](#-english)

---

## 📖 中文说明

**Network Flow Monitor v0.1.0** 首个公开版本发布。这是一款面向 **Windows 11 x64** 的轻量级、便携式按应用实时网络流量监控工具，无需安装内核驱动，基于 Windows 原生 **ETW (Event Tracing for Windows)** 与 **C++20 Win32/WebView2 + React 19** 构建。

### ✨ 核心特性

- **双层同场形变过渡（贴边流光胶囊 ⇄ 监控面板）**
  - 默认停靠于屏幕左/右边缘的紧凑贴边胶囊（默认 `10 × 64 DIP`），采用对数双向速率映射与可自定义双色速度渐变（内置 5 组精选配色 + 2D 拾色器）。
  - 鼠标悬停（`350 ms`）或点击胶囊即刻经阻尼曲线展开为 `340 DIP` 实时监控面板，展示全局上下行总速率与带真实 `.exe` 图标、FLIP 顺滑重排动画的 **Top N 应用实时流量排行榜**。
  - 跨越系统拖拽阈值后接入 Windows 原生移动循环，释放后自动识别多显示器工作区并吸附至左/右边缘，支持 `4 px` 边缘细线自动隐藏与全屏应用/游戏防误触（锁定穿透或自动隐藏）。

- **实时 ETW 进程级流量采集**
  - 独立 `NetworkFlowMonitor.SystemTrace` 实时 ETW 会话，统计 IPv4/IPv6 TCP 与 UDP 流量，不注入 Explorer、不依赖内核驱动。
  - 基于进程启动代际追踪（`ProcessInstanceId`）防止 Windows PID 复用串号，通过 Owner-Scoped 本地命名管道（`Protocol V1`）以 `4 Hz` 推送总速率、以 `1 Hz` 推送应用排行快照。

- **普通权限启动与一次性 ETW 持久授权**
  - 主程序 `NetworkFlowMonitor.exe` 始终以普通用户权限运行，支持无弹窗 `HKCU\Run` 登录开机自启。
  - 首次运行若缺少 ETW 权限，自动按需触发原生 UAC（`runas`）完成一次性持久授权（加入 `Performance Log Users` 组、授予 `SeSystemProfilePrivilege` 并配置 ETW GUID DACL），后续启动无需再次提权。

- **纯净便携交付与通用设置在线自更新**
  - 单文件便携包 `NetworkFlowMonitor-0.1.0-win-x64.zip` 静态链接 MSVC 运行库与 WebView2 加载器；所有运行期配置（`data/config.json`）、WebView2 数据（`data/webview2/`）与滚动日志（`logs/`）均保存在软件根目录内。
  - 在「设置中心 -> 通用」中内置 GitHub Release 在线检查更新、实时下载进度展示以及原地热替换重启能力。

### 📦 发行包信息

- **便携归档包**：`NetworkFlowMonitor-0.1.0-win-x64.zip`
- **运行环境要求**：Windows 11 24H2 x64（含 Microsoft Edge WebView2 Evergreen Runtime）

## 🌐 English

Initial public release of **Network Flow Monitor v0.1.0**, a lightweight, portable per-application real-time network traffic monitor for **Windows 11 x64** built on native **Windows ETW (Event Tracing for Windows)**, a **C++20 Win32/WebView2 Product Host**, and **React 19**.

### ✨ Highlights

- **Dual-Surface Morphing (Edge-Docked Capsule ⇄ Monitor Panel)**
  - Compact edge-docked capsule (default `10 × 64 DIP`) with logarithmic bidirectional download/upload gradient fills, 5 curated dual-tone color presets, and an interactive 2D HSV color picker.
  - Smoothly morphs into a `340 DIP` monitor panel on hover (`350 ms`) or click, displaying live total throughput and a **Top N Application Traffic Leaderboard** with extracted 32-bit ARGB `.exe` icons and FLIP reordering animations.
  - Native `WM_SYSCOMMAND` drag-and-snap to left/right monitor work-area edges, `4 px` auto-hide peek strip, and automatic fullscreen app/game protection (`ignore_hover_when_fullscreen` OS click-through lock and `hide_capsule_when_fullscreen`).

- **Real-Time ETW Per-Application Traffic Accounting**
  - Dedicated `NetworkFlowMonitor.SystemTrace` real-time ETW session capturing IPv4/IPv6 TCP & UDP bytes without kernel drivers or Explorer injection.
  - Generation-tracked process identity (`ProcessInstanceId`) protecting against Windows PID reuse, streaming `4 Hz` traffic ticks and `1 Hz` ranking snapshots over an owner-scoped Named Pipe (`Protocol V1`).

- **Standard-User Host & One-Time Persistent ETW Authorization**
  - `NetworkFlowMonitor.exe` runs as a standard user for clean `HKCU\Run` login startup without UAC prompts.
  - On-demand native UAC elevation (`runas`) on first launch configures persistent ETW permissions (`Performance Log Users` membership + `SeSystemProfilePrivilege` + ETW GUID DACL) so subsequent launches require no elevation.

- **Self-Contained Portable Delivery & Online In-Place Updater**
  - Portable `NetworkFlowMonitor-0.1.0-win-x64.zip` statically links the MSVC runtime and WebView2 loader; all configuration (`data/config.json`), WebView2 profile (`data/webview2/`), and rotating diagnostic logs (`logs/`) stay inside the application root.
  - Built-in GitHub Release update checker, live download progress, and one-click in-place portable binary replacement & restart in **Settings -> General**.

### 📦 Portable Package

- **Archive**: `NetworkFlowMonitor-0.1.0-win-x64.zip`
- **Target OS**: Windows 11 24H2 x64 (with Microsoft Edge WebView2 Evergreen Runtime)
